column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rule configuration (used by the `dast` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml).
# Format: <plugin id> TAB <IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL|OUTOFSCOPE> TAB (<rule name>) [TAB <reason>] - at least two tabs per line.
# Policy: the CI gate fails on any High-risk alert and turns Medium/Low into warnings, independent of this file.
# IGNORE removes a rule from the gate and the console summary (the HTML/JSON report still lists it).
# Only add IGNORE for a documented false positive or a purely informational rule, with the reason in the 4th column.
# Set a rule to FAIL to make it blocking even below High risk.
# Security headers: web/server/headers.js, set on every response by the server entry (web/server/index.js; static files and the
# prerendered /offline page included) and by web/src/hooks.server.ts. The CSP lives in web/vite.config.ts.
# Known, accepted findings (NOT suppressed, they show up as warnings; anything new on top of these is worth a look):
#   10055 CSP: style-src 'unsafe-inline' - only the fallback for engines without CSP Level 3 (the old Chromium the Tizen/webOS TV
#         shells run the app in reads neither style-src-elem nor style-src-attr). Current browsers get style-src-elem 'self' (no
#         inline <style> at all) and style-src-attr 'unsafe-inline' (Svelte renders and sets style="" attributes; a hash or nonce
#         cannot cover an attribute). The Cast receiver page (/cast-receiver/, lib/cast/receiverPage.ts) keeps its own
#         style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' for Google's receiver framework until it is checked on a device.
#   90004 Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing (HTML) - require-corp (or credentialless) would block the trailer iframe
#         (youtube-nocookie.com) and the Cast sender script from www.gstatic.com; the app needs no cross-origin isolation.
#   2     Private IP Disclosure - false positive: the help text of the "home networks" setting (i18n strings bundled into a JS
#         chunk) shows 192.168.0.0/16 as the example network. No address of any real host is in the build.
#   10096 Timestamp Disclosure - Unix - false positive: 1831565813 = 0x6d2b79f5, the mulberry32 PRNG constant of the login
#         wall's fallback art (lib/auth/flow.ts fallbackArt), in a JS chunk.

column4: Informational only: tells the scanner that the AJAX spider would find more; not a vulnerability.
